correctness.rationale: Write F=β exp(−U/N) S V/N with U=u1 I+u2 A and V=I+θ A. The exact derivatives are F_S=F(1/S−1/N+U/N²), F_Q=F_E=F_R=F(−1/N+U/N²), F_I=F(1/V−(u1+1)/N+U/N²), F_A=F(θ/V−(u2+1)/N+U/N²). Hence −∂H/∂R=(λ1−λ3)F_R+μλ6, not merely μλ6. The terms −λ1 u3S+λ2u3S contribute (λ1−λ2)u3 to −∂H/∂S, not (λ1−λ3)u3. The source verify.py constructs the full symbolic Hamiltonian and checks all six corrected equations; the discrepancy is structurally nonzero at positive interior states. The terminal Taylor analysis is consistent but not necessary for the counterexample.
